format: Hype reaction: open with high-energy news announcement, name the catalyst and the price move, tie it to broader sector sentiment, close with implied follow for more.
hookPattern: [Person/company] just moved [ticker] [X]% and the whole [sector] trade is back.
hook: Jensen Huang just moved NVIDIA [VERIFY] over 35% in a single session.
